trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 and unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: all three production regions now run v2.3.0. Rollback was verified as executed. Since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production, no change-manager approval was required.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback action; the on-call engineer has been paged.
4. **Verified recovery**: post-rollback health check shows checkout-api healthy again with the error rate down to 0.2%.

No further action needed — service is stable on v2.3.0.
